card.name: Words that open a short instruction or threshold
card.fires_on: Small words that start a short follow-on phrase in label text: 'or' after a lab threshold (before 'higher' or 'greater'), '(' before 'i.e.' after 'if not recently available', and 'Call' or 'call' before an emergency instruction.

modes.label: Or after a threshold
modes.description: The word 'or' after a lab value in a withhold-until instruction, just before 'higher', 'greater' or a grade.
modes.example: Withhold EPKINLY until absolute neutrophil count is 1 × 10 9 /L<< or>> higher.

modes.label: Parenthesis before i.e.
modes.description: An opening bracket after 'if not recently available' that introduces a time window.
modes.example: Obtain serum transaminases (ALT and AST) and total bilirubin, if not recently available<< (>>i.e., within 3 months),

modes.label: The emergency call instruction
modes.description: The verb 'Call' or 'call' before 911 or emergency medical support.
modes.example: A licensed medical professional should be consulted for diagnosis and treatment of any and all medical conditions.<< Call>> 911 for all medical emergencies
